research_question: Does empirical multivariate resampling of historical 50-target paired-difference blocks materially change the estimated joint probability of satisfying the fixed four-metric three-line strict gate, relative to E046's normal-theory independence approximation?
novelty: New uncertainty-design method: preserve the joint four-endpoint distribution by resampling complete historical block vectors together, and preserve a final remainder block by sampling contiguous windows of exactly the remainder length. E046 used a normal-theory approximation and an independence product; this study estimates joint gate probability under an empirical dependence-preserving block-resampling stress design.

canonical_current_data.use: Integrity/cutoff check only; target 1250 outcome is not used in E078 power simulation.

historical_scope.use_restriction: Historical planning variance and endpoint dependence only; no model tuning, candidate ranking, or purchase-policy promotion.

endpoints.exact_null_geometry: Three pairwise-disjoint six-number tickets, union18; use the exact null constants from E045.

frozen_design.source_blocks: 16 consecutive non-overlapping 50-target blocks for targets 401..1200, plus final 49-target remainder 1201..1249.
frozen_design.full_block_resampling: Sample complete 50-target four-metric block-mean vectors jointly with replacement from the 16 observed full blocks.
frozen_design.remainder_resampling: If prospective N mod 50 is nonzero, sample the final remainder block from all contiguous historical source windows of exactly that remainder length; keep it as a separate block in both weighted mean and block-share gate.
frozen_design.strict_joint_success: All four planning lower bounds strictly >0 AND any2-positive block share >=0.65; the final remainder block counts as a block.
frozen_design.comparator: E046 joint_power_independence_approx and conservative union-bound lower at matching target counts/effect sizes.

inference_limits: This is a design-only empirical resampling approximation, not the operational moving-block bootstrap applied to prospective target observations.
Only 16 full historical blocks plus one 49-target remainder are available; empirical support is limited.
All source targets are previously observed historical data; 1244-1249 are contaminated live-history diagnostics.
The resampling model assumes exchangeability of sampled historical block vectors for planning and cannot prove future stationarity.
No model, candidate set, allocator, strict threshold, alpha, or block length is changed.
No prospective minimum target count or completion rule is selected or adopted.
No candidate numbers, top30, core/tail list, or purchase lines may be generated or displayed.
promotion_effect: NONE. Design-only result cannot create STRICT_PASS_READY, cannot satisfy prospective confirmation, and cannot release any numbers.
